definition: Per edge, max metric among its valid P/C/CP/PC artifacts minus P. P is always valid and available. Invalid programs are ineligible, not assigned a fictitious score.
independent_checks: Python Decimal arithmetic on the same hash-pinned CSV
boundaries: Original factorial causal analysis remains 5/8 complete; this view does not impute its missing contrasts or revise its gate.
This oracle can inspect reused development outcomes and select for free. It is a deliberately optimistic bound for selection within this fixed pool, not a deployable rule.
The bound is algebraic for these observed scores, not a confidence bound on population performance or unobserved reruns.
Does not bound new generation, repairs, new executions or combinations of predictions/program fragments.
Only a selected old date-feature example is positive; its already-computed conditional interval crosses zero.
Do not pool AUC and Jaccard into a mean or treat repeated parents as independent replications.
Cannot estimate prevalence on natural MLE edits: source, dependency and runtime eligibility filters are restrictive.
No new labels, predictions, model fits, GPU jobs or remote result files were read for this calculation.
